_: The media library's own words (tools/media-library/build.mjs): each collection's title and blurb, the titles of sets no catalog names, a picture's shot, and how a caption joins two names. A word is { locale: text } or { "catalog": key }, a key both src/ui/i18nCatalog files carry. A picture's own title and line come from its manifest or the catalogs (tools/media-library/sources.mjs), never from here and never from a file name.

blurb.en-US: Every battle scene filmed in the game engine, by battlefield: each scene with its close-up and other moments, then the Scene Studio's sequences and the motion-blur studies.
blurb.zh-CN: 在游戏引擎中拍摄的全部战斗场景，按战场分组：每个场景附特写与其他瞬间，然后是场景工作室的镜头序列与运动模糊研究。

blurb.en-US: Every vehicle on its battlefield, with a close-up and other moments, by country.
blurb.zh-CN: 每辆载具在其战场上的画面，附特写与其他瞬间，按国家分组。

blurb.en-US: Two sides, one frame: the duels at ground level by time of day, then from above.
blurb.zh-CN: 两方同框：地面视角的对决按时段分组，然后是俯瞰视角。

blurb.en-US: Firefights filmed in the game engine: one on one, and one against two.
blurb.zh-CN: 在游戏引擎中拍摄的交火：一对一，以及以一敌二。

blurb.en-US: The game's features, mechanics and modes, each mode on the Deploy screen, the campaign's operations and the first game's tips.
blurb.zh-CN: 游戏的功能、机制与模式，出击界面上的各个模式，战役中的各场行动，以及第一局的提示。

blurb.en-US: Key art from the media kit, by time of day, and the posters.
blurb.zh-CN: 媒体包中的主视觉，按时段分组，以及海报。

blurb.en-US: Every battlefield at its landmark, seen from above, and its map card.
blurb.zh-CN: 每个战场的地标画面、俯瞰图，以及它的地图卡。

blurb.en-US: The game's screens: in battle, the Garage, the Tank Gallery and the Scene Studio.
blurb.zh-CN: 游戏的各个界面：战斗中、车库、坦克画廊与场景工作室。
